tools.name: search
tools.description: Search facts, transcript passages and topics at once, for clients that only use the generic search/fetch pair (ChatGPT Deep Research). Returns up to 10 ids with a title, link and short snippet; pass an id to fetch for the full text. Other clients should prefer search_facts (quotes with speaker and t

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get the full text for an id returned by search: an episode's summary and facts, a transcript passage with context, or a topic's facts.

tools.name: search_facts
tools.description: Keyword search over sourced facts: each hit is a claim with the speaker's exact quote, timestamp, episode and links. Best for 'what did X say about Y' (search 'X Y', not the whole question). Results include show_slug and episode_slug for get_episode or get_transcript. Pages via offset/next_offset; t

tools.name: search_transcripts
tools.description: Keyword search over full transcripts, returning matching paragraphs with a snippet, speaker, timestamp and a link to the exact paragraph. Use when search_facts finds nothing or you need the surrounding conversation: call get_transcript with show_slug, episode_slug and offset set to the hit's paragra

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List companies, people and subjects that have topic pages of sourced facts, most facts first. Filter with query; pass a slug to get_topic.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: Get sourced facts about one company, person or subject across all shows, grouped by episode, 20 facts per page by default. total is the topic's fact count; pass next_offset as offset for the next page.

tools.name: list_shows
tools.description: List shows with their slug, host and episode count, 25 per page by title. Filter with query; descriptions are shortened.

tools.name: list_episodes
tools.description: List a show's episodes, newest first, with episode_slug, publish date and fact count. Pages via offset/next_offset.

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description: Get an episode's summary, publish date, named speakers and every sourced fact with quote and timestamp.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Get a transcript with speakers and timestamps, up to 40 paragraphs (about 12k characters) per page. total is the paragraph count; pass next_offset as offset for the next page.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, search_transcripts, get_transcript · Public sink: list_episodes, get_episode.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, search_transcripts, get_transcript · Public sink: list_episodes, get_episode

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
